nextStoryContext: US-R2-001's underlying finding (US-002 AC2 oracle unsatisfiable against src/vendor/_generated.ts, the CAM-433 literal-sweep-vs-codegen conflict) was already resolved before this dispatch by an out-of-band operator PRD amendment (commit 1f39e11a, sanctioned after the prior 3 identical BLOCKED_QUALITY dispatches tripped CAM-214's circuit breaker): scripts/cam/prd.json's US-002 AC2 oracle now carries --exclude='_generated.ts'. The only edit made was marking the patterns.md:1032 bullet [resolved 2026-07] with the resolution mechanism (operator-amendment path), so a future implementer/reviewer session reads it as closed rather than re-investigating the same defect. The amendment-path gap itself (no first-class in-loop channel for 'operator, please apply this prd.json patch' short of manual intervention after a circuit-break) remains tracked as CAM-436, out of scope here.
